verdict.rationale: The pack documents SharePoint's REST and Graph APIs for file CRUD, batching, addressing and webhooks, but no item describes a search API over filenames or full-text content. The only community mention of search (sharepoint-comm-9) says that, by default, search indexed only Office metadata. That contradicts the story rather than supporting it, so no capability is evidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, search reaches inside files — a documented search API over filenames and full-text content, not just prefix matching
